---
name: Behavior report
about: The agent did not follow the skill, or the skill told it to do the wrong thing
title: ""
labels: behavior
assignees: ""
---

**Host and model**
Host (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Devin, Hermes, other) and its version; model name and version if you know it.

**Skill version**
The `version` in `skills/sureforge/SKILL.md` or the release tag you installed.

**What you asked for**
The prompt, with private details replaced. Say whether you invoked SureForge by name or expected it to activate on its own.

**What the agent did**
The relevant part of the agent's behavior. Please do not paste full transcripts, credentials, or personal data.

**What you expected**
Which phase, gate, or rule in the skill text you expected to apply, if you can point to it.

**Anything else**
Tools that were missing (no question tool, no reviewer, no network), or host settings that may matter.
